title: R3 · belly and chisel
changes: Convex belly put back on the outer blade edge, bottoming near 60% of the blade (y 609 vs 601 px before), then the taper into the needle point. The inner edge is now one straight line from the first tooth to the point.
Chisel tip: tip_thick 0.5 mm and a flatter wedge near the point. Point is 0.4 mm wide x 0.6 mm thick at 0.5 mm back, 0.8 x 0.8 at 1 mm, 1.5 x 1.1 at 2 mm (r2: 0.3 x 1.4, 0.6 x 1.6, 1.1 x 2.1).
Ridges: 21 fine V teeth, 0.35 mm deep, 0.7 mm mouth, 1.0 mm pitch (r2: 11 at 0.9 / 1.3 / 1.7), on the inner gripping edge only. Pitch 5.2 px chosen because 5.0 to 5.1 gave non-manifold meshes.
Holes: shank chain 15 px down to 9.5 px (r2: 13.5 to 8), so neighbours nearly touch; head honeycomb snapped 60% toward a hex lattice and holes as large as the walls allow (up to 18 px = 3.6 mm).
Mid-shank step on the inner edge made steeper and moved about 7 px toward the root.

Closed pose: closed_trim turns each finger 3.3 deg outwards of the photo pose. The blades now sit 1.0 mm apart at the point and 3.0 mm at the first tooth (r2: 1 mm to about 5.8 mm). Full flush (5.5 deg) is impossible: the inner shank swells at about z=54 mm would collide, so this is the largest turn that clears.
review: Final independent review (Sonnet 5.5): 8.5/10. Fixed: outer belly, chisel tip, fine ridges, step; mostly fixed: hole chain/honeycomb; closed gap improved (1.0 mm, collision-limited). Remaining: belly slightly lean vs two_hands; head honeycomb a bit irregular/small; J-claw toe thin; tip teeth slightly ragged in iso (slicer-check before printing); tip ~0.8 mm wide at 1 mm back.
